description: Formulas & keyframe presets for dynamic auto-zooming and framing

face_punch_in_120.name: Face Punch-In (1.20x)
face_punch_in_120.best_for: Punching in on face when a new key sentence or punchline starts

dynamic_snap_zoom_135.name: Extreme Snap Zoom (1.35x)
dynamic_snap_zoom_135.best_for: Extreme reaction, shocking statement, or meme reaction

slow_retention_creep.name: Slow Retention Creep (1.00x -> 1.08x)
slow_retention_creep.best_for: Long speaking segments (prevents viewer drop-off / maintains retention)

alternating_ab_camera.name: Alternating A/B Camera Cut
alternating_ab_camera.cut_interval_rule: Switch every 2.5 to 4.5 seconds on sentence pauses
